title: Basic content-box geometry
expectedBehavior: An absolutely positioned content-box includes padding and border outside its declared width and height.

title: Explicit border-box geometry
expectedBehavior: Padding and border remain inside an explicitly declared border-box size.

title: Viewport-root percentage sizing
expectedBehavior: Percentage offsets and dimensions resolve against the root containing block.

title: Nested absolute positioning
expectedBehavior: An absolute child uses the padding box of its positioned parent as its containing block.

title: Cascade specificity and source order
expectedBehavior: Type, class, ID, source order, compound selectors, and inline styles follow the CSS cascade.

title: Inherited text properties
expectedBehavior: A child inherits color and typography from its parent when it has no declaration of its own.

title: Normal block sibling flow
expectedBehavior: Block children start at the content edge and stack vertically in source order.

title: Inline-block run and display none
expectedBehavior: Inline-block siblings share a line and display:none contributes neither rendering nor layout space.

title: Multiline wrapping and pixel line height
expectedBehavior: Normal whitespace wraps at word boundaries and pixel line-height uses the resolved font size.

title: Preserved lines and centered text
expectedBehavior: Pre-line preserves explicit line breaks, collapses spaces, and centers each rendered line.

title: Flex row gap and centered alignment
expectedBehavior: A flex row centers its item group on the main axis, centers unequal item heights on the cross axis, and applies column gap once.

title: Flex column gap and end alignment
expectedBehavior: A flex column packs items at the main-axis end, aligns unequal widths at the cross-axis end, and applies row gap once.

title: Flex growth with gap
expectedBehavior: Flex growth distributes content-box free space by grow factor after reserving the main-axis gap exactly once.

title: Heading and paragraph browser defaults
expectedBehavior: Unstyled headings and paragraphs use centralized browser-like typography, auto block sizing, and vertical margins.

title: Unordered list flow and markers
expectedBehavior: List items stack at intrinsic line-box height inside the list content box and render outside disc markers.

title: Ordered list flow and markers
expectedBehavior: Ordered list items stack at intrinsic line-box height and render sequential decimal markers outside the content box.

title: Fixed table rows and columns
expectedBehavior: A fixed-size two-by-two table divides its border-free grid evenly across rows and columns.

title: Explicit table column widths
expectedBehavior: Fixed table columns honor explicit pixel widths instead of being redistributed equally.

title: Image intrinsic dimensions
expectedBehavior: An image without declared CSS dimensions uses the deterministic asset’s natural width and height.

title: Image object-fit contain
expectedBehavior: Contain preserves the image aspect ratio, centers it, and exposes the element background as letterboxing.

title: Image object-fit cover
expectedBehavior: Cover fills the image box while preserving aspect ratio and cropping equally from the long axis.

title: Explicitly styled button
expectedBehavior: An explicitly styled button uses the declared border box, background, border, radius, and centered label without relying on native browser chrome.

title: Explicitly styled text input
expectedBehavior: An explicitly styled text input uses the declared border box and renders its value with browser-like content insets.

title: Checked and disabled checkbox states
expectedBehavior: Explicitly styled checkboxes preserve independent width and height, initialize checked state visibly, and retain disabled opacity without invented labels.

title: Overlapping positioned siblings by z-index
expectedBehavior: A positioned sibling with the higher stylesheet z-index paints above a later DOM sibling throughout their overlap.

title: Minimum and maximum size constraints
expectedBehavior: Minimum constraints expand undersized boxes and maximum constraints shrink oversized boxes on both axes.

title: Letter and word spacing
expectedBehavior: Letter-spacing and word-spacing affect both painted glyph positions and the intrinsic width of an auto-sized inline box.

title: Inline flex outer and inner flow
expectedBehavior: Inline-flex containers participate in an inline formatting row while laying out their own children with flexbox.

title: Wrapped flex lines and align-content
expectedBehavior: Flex items wrap onto multiple rows, preserve row and column gaps, and distribute lines with align-content.

title: Negative and auto stacking inside a context
expectedBehavior: A negative z-index child paints above its stacking-context parent background but below a later auto-z sibling.
